wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/uv/msg16.txt: fix(streams): a user wrapper's read buffer was written and never read back

php keeps what a read did not need in the stream's OWN read buffer, and every reader sees it.
elephc fills that buffer on a user-registered wrapper and then four separate readers ignored it,
each in its own way. All four are silent — a value comes back, just the wrong one — and all four
are reachable only through a stream a program registers itself, which is why the file and
`php://memory` paths stayed green throughout.
